title: An Inclusive and Lightweight Approach to Federated Continual Learning for Cultural Heritage
abstract: arXiv:2608.20038v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Artificial intelligence can support cultural heritage and digital humanities through large-scale retrieval and analysis of digitized collections. However, cultural heritage data are often distributed across institutions, constrained by ownership and access restrictions, and continuously evolving over time. Federated Continual Learning (FCL) is well suited to this setting, as it enables models to learn from distributed and sequential data without sharing raw collections. In this paper, we propose FedCurv-DR, a lightweight, regularisation-based FCL strategy. The method accumulates parameter-importance estimates across clients and experiences to protect learned knowledge, while updating them only at fixed intervals to minimize communication and computation overhead. We evaluate FedCurv-DR in a continual learning scenario using the WikiArt image dataset for genre classification with evolving styles, reporting performance, energy, and fairn

translated_title: 一种面向文化遗产的包容且轻量级联邦持续学习方法
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.20038v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：人工智能可以通过大规模检索和分析数字化馆藏来支持文化遗产和数字人文学科。然而，文化遗产数据通常分布在各个机构之间，受所有权和访问限制的约束，并且随着时间的推移不断演变。联邦持续学习（FCL）非常适合这种场景，因为它使模型能够在不共享原始馆藏的情况下，从分布式和序列化数据中学习。在本文中，我们提出了FedCurv-DR，一种基于正则化的轻量级FCL策略。该方法跨客户端和经验累积参数重要性估计以保护已学知识，同时仅以固定间隔更新这些估计，以最小化通信和计算开销。我们在使用WikiArt图像数据集进行流派分类的持续学习场景中评估了FedCurv-DR，该数据集包含不断演变的风格，并报告了性能、能耗和公平性指标。
tldr: 本文提出了一种轻量级、基于正则化的联邦持续学习策略FedCurv-DR，通过间隔更新参数重要性估计来减少通信开销，在保护文化遗产知识的同时实现高效且公平的学习。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes FedCurv-DR, a lightweight regularization-based federated continual learning strategy that reduces communication overhead by periodically updating parameter-importance estimates, enabling efficient and fair learning while preserving cultural heritage knowledge.
